title: Builder BLD-901: Full matrix

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-901.

detail:
BZ Hardening, pass BLD-901 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-901). Full matrix. Scope: all builder paths. Build: Render every role × variant × theme × surface × device (1600, 1200, 900, 390). Fix overflow, zero-height and contrast findings. Done when: Coverage 1.00 on declared roles; No horizontal overflow at 390. Gates: audit:themes render matrix, check:theme-conformance, pr-compare visual suite, a11y ratchet, check:build-budget and check:shell-weight, editor-bytes-on-public-render ratchet, raw-css-paths ratchet, check:contrast, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-303, BLD-205. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Full matrix: lib/builder/matrix.ts declares every role x variant x theme (13, New World in both modes) x surface x device (1600, 1200, 900, 390), 13,728 cells; pnpm audit:builder-matrix draws each role variant in its theme's own sheet and measures it at the six widths the surfaces give those devices. Reading on main: coverage 1.00, no horizontal overflow at any width (390 included), no zero-height section. Contrast: 3 themes had small-text misses of one token each. New World Day fixed (muted ink #6E6862, the Commons day value frequency.css already uses). Temple kit and Free Human held as BLD-903, because fixing them rewrites two hash pins. Scope is block roles in the theme sheets; the shell chrome is not in this matrix.
